## Rationale
Seeds three of the strongest theory-to-architecture rows: the Ladder-plus-A6 mechanism (PROVEN) traces to the admission axis and governed acts in the FA layered model, with the session-bootstrap boundary check as the nearest running relative per GN-46, classified DIRECTLY DERIVED and called the strongest row; the pre-aggregation normalization necessity (PROVEN, theorem T-K6a) traces to a mandatory dedup/dependency stage required in any evidence service, classified DIRECTLY DERIVED because the theorem forces the stage; and Underdetermined/NOT_IDENTIFIABLE outcomes (PROVEN, theorem P-02) should trace to first-class outcome values in assurance interfaces but currently have none, classified as a 'THEORY WITHOUT ARCHITECTURAL CARRIER' -- a positive-direction gap where proven theory has no corresponding architecture yet [S1478]. Seeds three further rows: structured-not-scalar assessments (PROVEN, qualified theorem T-K7) trace to (S+, S-, Conflict, ...) surfaces with labeled scalar projections, derived at the doctrine level but with component mapping still open; Replay classes (CONDITIONALLY PROVEN) trace to an event store plus recorded-oracle artifacts plus version references, classified CONSISTENT-BUT-INDEPENDENTLY-DESIGNED since event sourcing itself is a design choice and the recording rule is a governance matter, not a theory consequence; the Zero operator (CONDITIONALLY PROVEN) traces to a gap-evaluation service over a contract plus evaluator plugins, classified DERIVED-modulo-eta because the contract input remains unconstructed [S1478]. Seeds three remaining rows: the escalation law (sound) traces to a human-governance escalation path, a DIRECTLY DERIVED candidate; federation of state spaces (corpus-argued, but its disposition versus a single unified product state space is undecided) has no determined architectural trace and is classified THEORY-DOES-NOT-DETERMINE until a governance decision C-027 is made; the Kernel(s) concept has no single architectural trace and must instead carry the corpus's 5-sense disambiguation, with any naming of a 'kernel service' being flagged as an IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE, not a theory consequence; invariant enforcement's per-KI enforcement locus (from DDD-6) is left open pending plans 08 and 10 [S1478].
